This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They possessed [[Color/Legends|reddish-brown]] skin with large flat heads lined with drooping lobes, lacking any other discernable facial features.<ref name="TSotFW" /> Sometime between [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]] and [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' places the [[Mission to Panna Prime|mission]] to [[Panna Prime]] after the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], which it also placed six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], corresponding to [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. {{SW|url=news/the-best-holidays-and-celebrations-in-the-galaxy-everybodys-invited-of-course|text=The Best Holidays and Celebrations in the Galaxy&hellip;and Empire Day, Too|int=The Best Holidays and Celebrations in the Galaxy&hellip;and Empire Day, Too|nolive=1}} mentions that ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' was one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the Battle of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin]], corresponding to [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of the mission as portrayed in ''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]'' must have occurred between 0.5 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and 1 ABY.</ref> at least three members of this specie could be found on the streets of [[Panna City]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Panna Prime]] when [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] arrived in search of a [[Serum (sleeping virus)|serum]] for the [[sleeping virus]] which was affecting [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="TSotFW" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The species appeared in ''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]'',<ref name="TSotFW" /> a cartoon that aired on television as part of the ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'',<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref> which aired on [[November 17]], [[1978]].<ref name="Boba Fett: Mystery Man">{{GalaxyCite|1|Boba Fett: Mystery Man in Not-So-Shining Armor}}</ref> The cartoon was later included as an [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]] on the [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Blu-ray Disc|Blu-ray]] release of ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''.<ref name="blu-ray">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref>
